title.en: Whenever it happens, it happens right
title.hi: Jab bhi ho, theek hi hota hai

body.en: Early, late, planned, changed at the last minute. None of it is a verdict on either of you. The only thing being asked of you now is to be there.
body.hi: Jaldi, der se, socha hua, aakhri pal par badla hua. Inmein se kuch bhi aap dono par faisla nahi hai. Ab aapse sirf itna maanga ja raha hai ki aap wahan hon.
